definitions.explanation: Without holding back or self-censoring. Used to describe honest opinions or feedback given without fear of causing offense. Almost always appears in the set phrase 忌憚のない意見.

examples.japanese: {忌憚|きたん}のない⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please give me your frank opinion.

examples.japanese: {忌憚|きたん}のない⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
{忌憚|きたん}のないご⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦いただければ→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧⟦{幸|さいわ}い→幸い：02774_saiwai⟧です。
examples.english: I would appreciate it if you could share your candid views.

notes:
⟦{忌憚|きたん}→忌憚：09456_kitan⟧ means "reserve" or "restraint" (from {忌|き} — to avoid + {憚|たん} — to hesitate). Adding ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ negates it: "without reserve." The word ⟦{忌憚|きたん}→忌憚：09456_kitan⟧ almost never appears outside this expression.

USAGE:
A formal, set expression used mainly in business and official contexts when inviting honest feedback. Typically used by someone in a senior position asking subordinates or participants to speak freely. The phrase signals that criticism is welcome and will not cause offense.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {忌憚|きたん}のない⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧ — frank opinion
- {忌憚|きたん}のないご⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧ — frank opinion (polite)
- {忌憚|きたん}のない⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧ — unreserved discussion
- ⟦{忌憚|きたん}→忌憚：09456_kitan⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{述|の}べる→述べる：02389_noberu⟧ — to state without reserve

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{率直|そっちょく}→率直：13491_socchoku⟧な — straightforward, direct (more common in everyday speech)
- ⟦{遠慮|えんりょ}→遠慮：01337_enryo⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧ — without holding back (less formal; ⟦{遠慮|えんりょ}→遠慮：01337_enryo⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦どうぞ→どうぞ：02920_douzo⟧ — please don't hold back)
- ⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{衣|きぬ}⟦{着|き}せない→着せる：13684_kiseru⟧ — not mincing words (stronger; implies bluntness)
